title: Long-term exercise training and inflammatory biomarkers in healthy subjects: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.

answer.design_quote: This meta-analysis investigated the effect of long-term exercise training (ET) including aerobic, resistance, and multicomponent ET on the levels of inflammatory biomarkers in randomized controlled trials (RCTs) involving healthy subjects.
answer.k_quote: Thirty-eight studies were included in the meta-analysis, involving 2,557 healthy subjects (mean age varies from 21 to 86 years).
